title: Editor state diagram
description: The life of one Editor while Term::run feeds it keys: the state is derived from its view, prompt and find fields, and Editor::handle checks them in that order (a prompt first, then the find bar, then the global keys Ctrl+S, Esc, F1/Ctrl+G, Tab/Shift+Tab, Ctrl+F/Ctrl+R, Ctrl+N/Ctrl+E, then the view's own keys). Any key other than an arrow resets the tap count. The waiting state is the assistant's save_waiting flag (assist.rs), which Term::run advances by calling Editor::tick every 100 ms while the editor is busy; the agent's own lifecycle is in Assist.state-diagram.json. Outside this machine, Term::run also ends with Cancel when SIGHUP, SIGTERM or SIGINT arrives or the terminal closes, and a lone Esc is delivered only after a 25 ms wait for the rest of a sequence.
machine: Editor (editor.rs), driven by Term::run through Editor::handle

states.description: Editor::new has built the editor for a buffer: the views are Edit, plus Files when changed files are given (the commit flow), plus Rebase for a git-rebase-todo file. For a commit message with an assistant, the agent starts composing when the message has only blank and comment lines. No key handled yet.
View::Edit with no prompt and no find bar: keys type, move, select, copy, undo and move lines.
View::Files (the right-hand column when the terminal is at least 60 columns wide, else the whole screen) with no prompt and no find bar: arrows move the list cursor and keys change file marks.
View::Rebase with no prompt and no find bar: arrows move between todo lines and keys set their commands or reorder them.
Prompt::Help: the key help for the current view is shown over it.
Prompt::Discard: `Discard your changes? y/n` after Esc with changed text or marks.
Prompt::Delete: `Delete N file(s) from disk? ... y/n` after Ctrl+S with files marked [DELETE].
The find bar (Editor.find is Some) is open over a view and takes every key; with replace on, over the editing view only.
Ctrl+S on an empty commit message while the agent composes: Assist.save_waiting is set and the status line says `Saving when <agent> is done (Esc stops waiting)`. Keys still act on the current view.
handle returned Outcome::Save; the caller writes the file.
handle returned Outcome::Cancel; nothing is written.

edit_key: typing, Enter, paste, Backspace, Delete, Ctrl+K, Ctrl+Z/Y, Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C/X/V, PageUp/Down; arrows move by one, a word or page on a double tap, the line or text edge on a triple tap (Taps::press), Shift selects, Alt+Up/Down moves the line.

files_key: Up/Down with taps move the list cursor, Space cycles the mark, A toggles all, Backspace marks [DELETE], PageUp/Down, Ctrl+Z undoes a mark change. Ctrl+R only shows `Replace works while editing (Tab)`.
rebase_key: p r e s f d set the line's command (a message on other lines), Alt+Up/Down moves the line, Up/Down with taps, Ctrl+Z/Y, PageUp/Down. Ctrl+R only shows `Replace works while editing (Tab)`.
